title: A Thorn for the Wolf
author: Wren Kavanagh
blurb: Ivo Nystrom, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
